summary: Cross-site elevator badge not granting floor access after desk relocation; coordinated ergonomic equipment shipment and return
description: Issue summary: After relocating desk and assigned hotdesk for new hire (L. Novak) from 3rd floor to temporary workspace on 6th floor, their company badge allows door entry but does not grant elevator access to the 6th floor. Concurrently, an ergonomic chair and external monitor shipment intended for the 6th-floor desk was split across two couriers and only the monitor arrived; chair is missing. This ticket coordinates facilities, security, and shipping to restore access and reconcile missing hardware.
impact: New hire onboarding delayed (workspace not fully usable). Facilities team needs to escalate elevator access provisioning to security; missing chair may require overnight replacement. Potential OSHA/ergonomics risk if employee uses unsuitable seating for extended periods.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) New hire swipes badge at 6th-floor elevator keypad -> elevator panels show "access denied" to floor 6.
2) Badge works for ground floor turnstile and office doors.
3) Inventory check shows monitor delivered (asset tag D-4123) but chair (asset tag C-9780) not in desk area or shipping bin.
4) Courier tracking shows chair marked delivered to 'building loading dock' but no check-in in facilities log.
investigation_notes:
- Confirmed badge contains expected access group in AccessControl system (group 'eu-office-6th').
- Door controller logs (2026-03-11 08:50–09:10) show elevator access deny events for badge ID 0x7A3F.
- Facilities walked loading dock 2026-03-12 10:00; no chair found. Reviewed CCTV timestamp window near dock (requires Security sign-off).
- Shipping vendor (FreightCo) provided tracking with ambiguous geotag; contact opened with vendor rep.
- Cross-referenced asset inventory: chair C-9780 shows assigned to L. Novak in AssetDB but status still 'in transit'.
- Hypotheses: (A) Badge provisioning replicated but not propagated to elevator controller cluster; (B) chair mis-scanned at dock or delivered to neighbor building entrance.
comments: Sofia Ramirez (Reporter) 2026-03-12: New hire is at desk but can't get to floor 6 via elevator — temporary workaround requested.
Evan Liu (Assignee) 2026-03-12: Reached out to Security for elevator ACL push. Also contacting FreightCo for precise delivery coordinates.
Security (via comment) 2026-03-13: Elevator controller cluster shows last policy sync 2026-03-10; pushing manual sync now. Will confirm when propagation completes.
Facilities (via comment) 2026-03-13: Checked alternate storage rooms and adjacent loading dock; nothing found. Requesting CCTV pull (Security) and vendor proof-of-delivery image.
Logistics (via comment) 2026-03-13: FreightCo responded: POD image blurry, appears to be delivered to 'Dock B' at 09:12. Asking on-site contact to verify.
resolution:
Temporary workaround: Security provisioned a time-limited elevator override for badge ID 0x7A3F allowing access to 6th floor until permanent fix. Facilities provided a loaner ergonomic chair (asset tag LOAN-045) same day.
Permanent actions: 1) Security to run a full elevator controller cluster sync and verify propagation (done 2026-03-13). 2) Logistics to escalate missing-chair claim with FreightCo; replacement chair ordered overnight and scheduled delivery 2026-03-14. 3) AssetDB updated: LOAN-045 assigned to L. Novak; once replacement delivered, LOAN-045 will be retrieved and re-entered into loaner pool. 4) Create follow-up SOP task to require POD images and on-site sign-off for cross-site deliveries (INT-9302 created).
follow_up_tasks: INT-9302 - SOP: cross-site delivery sign-off and POD requirement
IT-Access-541 - Elevator ACL monitoring alert to detect propagation delays
Facilities-Collect-Loaner-045 - Coordinate retrieval of loaner chair after replacement arrives
